observations: Low-pack four-stall corner vs U9 turn-off: pack_6V0_four_stall_loaded_V 4.388491 V (4.63 V with the camera shed, same model) is below U9's 4.505 V nominal / 4.802 V worst EN turn-off corner, so a 6 V open pack with four stalls would turn U9 off; parts_qualification 'Inference, stall input' says 'accept loss of peripheral operation while retaining logic/recovery'. Not counted: the 6 V open pack is below REQUIREMENTS' Pack row floor (>= 7.4 V resting at launch), whose four-stall requirement (BAT_IN above the 4.802 / 4.835 V corner) the 7.4 V case meets at 5.881 V; the sentence is a shedding policy, not a computed retention claim. Naming the U9 turn-off at that corner would remove the ambiguity (optional).

Rule 4 / D-R23-02 body-diode fire current: re-solving the bound budget (4.467803 ohm branch, 0.15 ohm pack, 13.064091 W, four 1.92 A stalls, VSD 0.7 / 1.0 V) gives 1.12747 / 1.06264 A; the records quote 1.128 / 1.063 A (round 23's whole 0.7 V column sits about +0.0005 A above this solve: 1.38948 / 1.19345 vs 1.390 / 1.194). 0.04 % difference, both above the 1.125 A floor; the 0.93-1.01x envelope and the >= 1.39x / >= 1.04x ratios hold. Model-precision noise, not counted.

M3_R10 USB-only bullet's 63.605 mm In2 USB_LIMITED track (0.0912 ohm) is 63.115 mm on a0ec075e (0.0905 ohm; 58.13 mm in series): already round 27 power observation; labelled a Round 18 calculation and conservative.

U400's RAW_PROTECTED input feed (In2 vias (14.1,7.6) / (14.1,8.5), 0.4 mm F.Cu to U400.2 / .3 through C400.1 / C401.1, two parallel routes) is not a K-power path; at 1.85 A (10.82 W at 5.85 V) a single 0.4 mm external run rises about 22.5 C by tools/ipc2152.py, and the current splits over two routes; K-width holds it >= 0.3 mm with <= 2 mm narrow runs. Seen in round 27; not a rule violation.

U400 / L400 loss '1.2-2.2 W' (M3_R10 Simulation, R10_VALIDATION row 26): with the budget's 85 / 80 % efficiencies the loss at 1.561 A is 1.48-2.16 W; the 1.2 W low end corresponds to about 88 % (round 20's basis). Labelled Inference; upper bound agrees; already a round 28 triage observation.

PORT_5V3 out of U400 design current 1.81 A (camera shorted): a single PORT_4V8 short with the camera on is 2.511-2.911 A prospective; the buck's 2.5-3.1 A peak limit and U401's thermal shutdown (about 8 W in a hard short) bound it to a non-continuous state, as 'Shared port fault budget' states. Not a continuous IPC-2152 design point.

One-via feeds outside SINGLE_OPEN_TAPS (in-memory taps run): U11.2 RAW_PROTECTED (24.3,66.0) is a recorded respin item (D-R19-09, owner row 22); U1.11 (one VDD pin) hangs on via 3V3 (22.60,52.15) while U1's other VDD pins and the In2 3V3 fill remain; not a regulator tap. All U11 / U9 / U400 / U401 / U2 GND ties, SS / dVdt / EN ties and the port feeds survive any single via open.

TPS25947 IN minimum is max(-15, VOUT-21) below -10 C (SLVSFC9C 6.1): the hot-plug retained-OUT bound 5.914 V after 2 s (1643.90 uF, R92 3354.66 ohm) gives VOUT-21 = -15.09 V, so the -15 V floor binds; ORDERING 8.3's 'wait >= 2 s after unplugging' matches the model's 2 s.
